reason: This plugin is primarily a knowledge-management integration: it connects DeepSeek Harness to a local Obsidian vault for note browsing and agent-assisted maintenance. Evidence from the repository metadata and README shows a vault home UI, note reading/search tasks, and optional write actions with journaling and rollback, which indicates a user-facing focus on managing local knowledge content rather than code generation or infrastructure tooling.

summaries.zh: 该插件用于在 DSH 中接入本地 Obsidian 笔记库，提供笔记入口与检索与编辑工作流，并支持在可配置审批下进行记录化的修改与回滚。
summaries.en: This plugin connects DSH to a local Obsidian vault, providing note navigation and search with optional user-approved edits, along with journaled change/rollback support.

capabilities: Read local Obsidian vault files and surface note content in DSH
Search and inspect vault structure/notes (including backlinks/broken links)
Create, update, append, delete, and move notes in supported workflows
Maintain a change journal and support one-click rollback of vault edits
Bind and use a configured local vault path with excluded directories and daily-note settings
Provide DSH UI flows for vault sessions and homepage widgets
